components.css: .ds-course{max-width:300px;color:var(--text,#182b49);font-family:ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;}.ds-course summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer}.ds-course summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-course summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--lp-blue,#2946d3);outline-offset:5px;}.ds-cover{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;height:270px;overflow:hidden;border-radius:12px;background:#f3e59b;color:#493c0c}.ds-category{font-size:11px;padding:17px 19px 0}.ds-cover h3{font-family:Bricolage,ui-sans-serif,sans-serif;font-size:25px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.025em;line-height:1.2;overflow-wrap:normal;flex-shrink:0;margin:13px 19px 20px}.ds-imprint{margin:auto 19px 20px;padding-top:18px;border-top:1px solid currentColor;font:17px/1.4 Georgia,serif}.ds-included{position:absolute;bottom:12px;right:12px;background:#fff;color:#182b49;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:4px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700}.ds-detail{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding-top:16px;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted,#526077)}.ds-detail svg{width:14px;height:14px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.7;border:1px solid var(--line,#d9dfE8);border-radius:50%;padding:6px;transition:transform 160ms ease}.ds-course[open] svg{transform:rotate(45deg)}.ds-course summary:hover svg{background:var(--text,#182b49);color:var(--bg,#f6f7f9)}.ds-course p{font-size:14px;line-height:1.65;color:var(--muted,#526077)}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-cover{height:230px;border-radius:10px}.ds-cover h3{font-size:18px}}@media(max-width:360px){.ds-cover h3{font-size:16px;margin-inline:10px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-detail svg{transition:none}}

narrative.overview: PASS MAO only: approachable studio reference library with the appetite of browsing record sleeves. The global site outside /pass-mao/ is unchanged.

rules.name: The Complete Title Rule
rules.body: Keep complete names and natural word wrapping; final mobile typography overrides take precedence.

rules.name: The Compact Proof Rule
rules.body: Center PM School portrait at 210px wide, or 180px below 600px, with maximum width 100% and natural aspect ratio.

dos: Scope the identity to PASS MAO.
Keep recognizable artwork, keyboard focus and native disclosures.
donts: Do not enlarge community proof to a full-column portrait.
Do not break words arbitrarily or clip course titles.
Do not add decorative waveforms, autoplay or fabricated social proof.
